description: Nasdaq is a leading technology platform that powers the world's economies, architecting the infrastructure of the world's most modern markets, powering the innovation economy and building trust in the financial system, and empowering economic opportunity by designing and deploying the technology, data and advanced analytics that enable its clients to capture opportunities, navigate risk and strengthen resilience. It manages, operates and provides its products and services in three business segments, Capital Access Platforms, Financial Technology and Market Services, and was founded in 1971 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of FINRA, with ownership broadened beginning in 2000 when FINRA restructured and began selling shares to FINRA members, investment companies and issuers listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market.
